title: virág, fa, fű, természet: Plants and Nature

sections.title: Plants and nature
sections.content: Four new words belong to the outdoors: *virág* ("flower"), *fa* ("tree"), *fű* ("grass") and *természet* ("nature"). You know *kert* and *park* from A1, the colours *zöld*, *piros* and *sárga* from A1, and the adjective before the noun (*piros virág*) from A1. You know *sok* + singular from A1 too: *sok fa*, never *sok fák*.

items.spanish: A kertben sok piros virág van.
items.english: There are many red flowers in the garden.
The children are sitting in the grass.

items.spanish: Az erdőben sok fa van, de nincs sok virág.
items.english: There are many trees in the forest, but not many flowers.

sections.content: Final *-a* and *-e* lengthen before an ending, as in *kutya – kutyák*: *fa – fák* ("trees"), *fát*. *fa* also means "wood". Say *a fűben* for "in the grass" and *a fán* for "on the tree".
